scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I submitted a loan application and I'm checking on the status. Could you tell me if it has been approved or denied? Also, what type of loan was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a conventional subordinate lien loan was denied. This field is not applicable because the loan was denied.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you tell me the reason for the denial? Also, what is my current debt-to-income ratio?
dialogue.agent: Your application was denied due to credit history. Your debt-to-income ratio is greater than 60%.

dialogue.user: I understand. Could you explain what that debt-to-income ratio means for my application? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: A debt-to-income ratio is the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. The field is not applicable because the loan was denied.

dialogue.user:
I see. Thank you for the information. That's all I needed to know.

<Neutral> I appreciate your help in explaining the denial and the debt-to-income ratio. It's clear that my credit history and high debt-to-income ratio were the main factors in the denial. I'm a bit disappointed, but I understand the reasons. I'll work on improving my credit and reducing my debt. Thank you for your time.
